data.gender_notes: Collin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Collin is an Old English name, possibly derived from Latin 'Cola' or 'Collus'. It is a masculine name, meaning 'powerful, victorious'. In the Bible, there is a character named Collos, who was a giant enemy of Paul. This name can be a reminder of the power and strength that comes from faith in God. The name Collin carries the meaning “Powerful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Collin usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
